findings.summary: The new test checks the sequence table through a dialect branch in a helper, not the SQLite-only marker its neighbours use, so the check is missing from the marker count.
The control test through the session's own connection checks the pool checkout count only, not the begin count.
An ORM select built from an update or delete statement with returning is refused by neither guard layer, only by the SQLite trigger; the PM noted it while grooming and it is not filed.

The Session hook alone misses an explicit id passed under a mapper attribute name other than id, so it is not a full second layer; the new docstring sentence stays true because the Engine listener refuses it.
